A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FERMAT study and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–F. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluations of nine VLMs on FERMAT, ablations, and human validation of the automated evaluator (Table 3, Sections 5.3–5.4, Appendix C).

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark experiments, ablations, and evaluator-validation results, including the numerical outcomes in Tables 3, 4, 6, and 7.

M1.justification: The benchmark-construction pipeline, direct and OCR-assisted evaluation procedures, cascaded setup, and GPT-4o evaluator remain identical, including the appendix prompts.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 2,244 handwritten solutions derived from 609 grade 7–12 problems, perturbation categories, and detection/localization/correction tasks. Printed-image and direct-text evaluation coverage is also unchanged.

E2.justification: The same nine VLMs appear in Tables 3 and 7. Comparator membership also remains unchanged within the context, input-modality, and evaluator-validation experiments.

E3.justification: Task prompts, temperature-zero inference, balanced accuracy/accuracy/F1 metrics, and the 464-output evaluator-validation design are unchanged. No evaluation setting or procedure is revised.

E4.justification: The context-information ablation (Table 4), input-modality study (Figure 4), error-detection reasoning analysis (Appendix D), and cascaded-flow analysis (Appendix E) are retained without changes.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. No repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results, and reported findings are unchanged throughout. Examples include Gemini-1.5-Pro's 0.77 EC+OCR accuracy in Table 3 and the 0.94 overall evaluator agreement in Table 6.

T1.justification: The formal task and evaluator mappings in Sections 3–4 and Appendix C are identical. No mathematical definition, assumption, derivation, or proof is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark contribution and claims about VLM limitations on handwritten mathematics and performance benefits from printed or textual inputs.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving OCR capabilities, cautious error detection, and cascaded failures remain unchanged, as do practical caveats and limitations. The repaired table references introduce no new explanation or qualification.

D1.justification: Appendix prompts, annotation and verification instructions, inference settings, and code/data links are unchanged. Section 4's repaired Appendix F reference points to details already present in v1.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, bibliography, and research positioning are identical. The repaired references are internal document pointers, not additional literature citations.

P1.justification: Three unresolved '??' references are repaired: Section 4 now names Appendix F, and Sections 5.1 and 5.2 name Table 7. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes; there is no broader rewriting or reorganization.

P2.justification: Figures and tables retain their designs, captions, and placement throughout, including the appendices. Page arrangement is preserved; the reference repairs only cause local prose rewrapping.

improvement.justification: Replacing three unresolved references with pointers to the existing Appendix F and Table 7 makes the prompts and supporting material easier to locate. This is a limited editorial improvement; the scientific evidence, interpretations, and limitations remain unchanged.
